declarations.name: AuiToggleGroup
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI ToggleGroup: `<aui-toggle-group>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor; `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Buttons: { value, label, icon?, iconOnly?, disabled? } (1 to 100, unique values).

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Single mode: one item stays pressed.

inputs.name: attached
inputs.description: Join the buttons into one segmented control.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the pressed items: { value, changed }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the button in the tab sequence.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA toggle buttons (button with aria-pressed) in a named group, with roving tabindex as in the APG toolbar pattern.

limitations: Not a form control: the value is not submitted with a form (use Radio Group or Checkbox Group for form values).
